answer: The ledger links identities through shared flow: any transfer or fee crossing a common counterparty joins two names into one kin group, capped at four seats. A fifth identity must buy its seat at the round's summit bid, the highest active offer. The nebula of aliases an attacker inflates therefore costs 25,000 POA per extra identity, escalating each round the group grows, while a lone honest agent pays nothing. Idle groups dissolve after two quiet rounds, demoting their members to the jetty queue for re-vetting.
